releases.notes:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.4

**Release Date:** October 21, 2026

Patch release. Desktop stops showing suggestion pills above the composer, plus small plugin and dashboard fixes, for the CLI and installer, the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud.

## Fixes

- **Desktop no longer shows suggestion pills above the composer.** The pills appeared for no clear reason, mostly nudging you to set up MCP servers. They and the helpers that only they used are gone. (#142559)

- **Plugins that install nothing skip the dependency consent step.** A plugin that declares no dependencies, or whose `pyproject.toml` installs nothing, now enables without an empty consent prompt. (#142569)

- **Dashboard: WhatsApp can be safely re-paired after logging out.** (#142439)

- **Desktop plugin review:** the surface lint no longer flags prototype writes; reviewers check them by hand. (#142586)

- **Desktop: the approval-mode chip follows the active profile's mode.** (#142565)

- **Release builds:** the desktop bundle's pre-build check gets enough time to verify archived build inputs when storage is slow. (#142623)

Also new in the plugin catalog: bubblewrap (bwrap terminal backend on Linux), Singularity/Apptainer, mcp-serve (Hermes as an MCP server), agent-importers (`hermes import-agent`, now with Cursor), inbox and workflow-record from Hermes Labs. Telegram Business moves to the Hermes Labs community tier.

## About this release

Measured at commit `4d04303818b`, the window since v0.22.3 contains **14 non-merge commits** across **82 changed files** (+1,475 / −3,022) and **13 merged PRs**.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.

- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.

- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.

- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: v0.22.3...v0.22.4

releases.notes:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.3

**Release Date:** October 21, 2026

Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~620 PRs merged since v0.22.2 into a stable release for the CLI and installer, the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.23.0.

## About this release

Measured at commit `5b147ab036d`, the window since v0.22.2 contains **2,911 non-merge commits** across **4,206 changed files** (+360,278 / −64,308), about **620 merged PRs** and **326 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: MCP progress notifications streamed as live tool progress, a refreshed classic CLI layout (glyph transcript, status line under the composer, two-line header), OAuth clients that plugins declare and Hermes signs in and refreshes, `hermes plugins update` offering every available plugin update plus an Update button for git-installed plugins in Desktop, steering and editing a queued prompt from Desktop, a guided subagent model and provider picker in Desktop, a live `/loop` countdown row in the CLI and TUI, opt-in Telegram DM topic transfer, a `post_compaction` plugin hook, a capabilities catalog, the Microsoft Store build going live automatically when a release publishes, session auto-prune back to opt-in with a one-time prompt when disk runs low, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt and one-slot DFlash drafts in the local runtime, and dozens of new plugin catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.23.0**, which will document everything from v0.22.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.

- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.

- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.

- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: v0.22.2...v0.22.3

value.content:
## How It Works

Two files make up the agent's memory:

| File | Purpose | Char Limit |
|------|---------|------------|
| **MEMORY.md** | Agent's personal notes — environment facts, conventions, things learned | 2,200 chars (~800 tokens) |
| **USER.md** | User profile — your preferences, communication style, expectations | 1,375 chars (~500 tokens) |

Both are stored in `~/.hermes/memories/` and are injected into the system prompt as a frozen snapshot at session start. The agent manages its own memory via the `memory` tool — it can add, patch, or remove entries.

:::caution One agent per Hermes home
Don't point two agent processes at the same Hermes home directory. Memory writes are automatic and load back into the system prompt at session start, so two writers sharing one home will compound each other's entries into state neither of them (nor you) authored. Memory is scoped per [profile](../profiles.md) by design — give a second agent its own profile, and if they need shared memory, use an [external memory provider](./memory-providers.md) instead.
:::

:::info
Character limits keep memory focused. Memory does **not** auto-compact: when a
write would exceed the limit, the `memory` tool returns an error instead of
silently dropping entries. The agent then makes room itself — consolidating or
removing entries in the same turn before retrying (see [What Happens When Memory
is Full](#what-happens-when-memory-is-full)). Note that `patch` is also bound
by the limit: a patch that lengthens an entry can still overflow, so the new
text must be shortened (or another entry removed) to fit.
:::
value.description: How Hermes Agent remembers across sessions — MEMORY.md, USER.md, and session search
value.title: Persistent Memory

value.desktop_packages:
Download the package for your platform from the
[Hermes website](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/).

- **Windows:** open the `.appinstaller` download with Windows App Installer.
  It installs the signed MSIX bundle and records its update source.
  Microsoft Store packages have separate Store ownership.
- **macOS:** open the DMG, then copy `Hermes.app` to Applications. The ZIP
  artifact carries the signed app used by the automatic updater.

Bundled packages contain the agent, Python, supported dependencies, and prebuilt
interfaces. First launch does not build that base runtime. Provider access and
optional integrations can still require network access.

A `Hermes-Setup` bootstrap installer is different: it downloads a source
installation and builds the desktop app. See [Hermes Desktop](../user-guide/desktop.md).

There is no separate remote-only Desktop download. To use Desktop with a Hermes
backend on another machine, install one of the packages above and connect it
from **Settings → Gateways**; see
[Connecting to a remote backend](../user-guide/desktop.md#connecting-to-a-remote-backend).

:::note
The macOS installer is **Apple Silicon only**. macOS on x86 (Intel) processors is [not a supported platform](./platform-support.md#unsupported).
:::

post.description:
To find which Hermes Agent docs page and section covers a topic (installation, configuration, providers, memory, skills, cron, messaging gateway, plugins, Nous Portal setup). Pass a hit's `path` and `anchor` to get_page as `path` and `section` for the full text.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

language.description:

Provider reference: allowed values ["en", "zh-Hans"].

limit.description:
Maximum hits, 1-20. Defaults to 10.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 20.

200.description:
Search the Hermes Agent docs through the site's own Algolia DocSearch index (the search box on hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs, public search-only key). Returns ranked section and paragraph hits in the index's order with heading hierarchy, URL, page path, section anchor and the matching paragraph. Keyword search with typo tolerance; `language` selects English or Simplified Chinese pages.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `anchor` | string | Section anchor (decoded); null for a page-level hit. Pass as get_page `section`. |
| `content` | string | The matching paragraph for `content` hits; null for heading hits. |
| `hierarchy` | string[] | Page title, then section headings down to the hit. |
| `language` | string |  |
| `path` | string | Page path for get_page, e.g. `user-guide/features/memory` (`index` is the docs home). |
| `rank` | number | 1-based position in the index's ranking. |
| `title` | string | The deepest heading of the hit (the page title for a page-level hit). |
| `type` | string | DocSearch record type: `lvl1`..`lvl6` for a heading, `content` for a paragraph. |
| `url` | string | Docs URL, with the section anchor when the hit is a section. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
